blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.29-15597 on September 5, 2023. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (ebb8f837f43b80985b455f06b6021ec6d880f02a979d34de35061cb55946fed8) and records an archive size of 28246199 bytes, approximately 28.2 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
